observed.caption: A large vulture with wings fully spread runs across dry, rocky ground in bright daylight.
observed.description: A single large bird with mottled brown and white plumage, a pale featherless head and neck, and broad wings extended outward is captured mid-stride on dry, dusty brown earth scattered with small dark rocks and pebbles. The bird's legs are extended forward with talons visible, and its dark shadow falls sharply on the ground beneath it. In the background, sparse clumps of dry yellow-brown grass grow from uneven, rocky soil under bright, harsh sunlight.
